pageHeader.subtitle: A platform empowering SMEs and enterprises across every organizational level: technicians, managers, and strategists.

sections.title: The problem
sections.body:
SMEs and enterprises need practical mindset and skill development, yet lack a single, all-in-one solution.

BISA Academy (*bisa* means "can" in Indonesian) packages these skills into short, hands-on programs with real practice and one-on-one-s.

items.title: Technicians
items.description: Classes for those aspiring to or currently working in technical roles, such as salespeople, accountants, bookkeepers, and administrators.

items.title: Managerials
items.description: Practical sessions on running teams, meetings, and projects for future leaders and young professionals.
